metadata.description: Thirty back-office agents for small and mid-size manufacturers and distributors. Each reads your exported files, writes reports locally and waits for a named person before anything that moves money, sends a message or changes a live system.

plugins.name: fairmake-bom-cost-rollup
plugins.description: Fairmake BOM Cost Rollup: every assembly's cost rebuilt from its bill of materials and latest purchase prices, against its standard cost, with missing and stale prices and BOM loops. Loads nothing.

plugins.name: fairmake-bom-routing-gaps
plugins.description: Fairmake BOM Routing Gaps: made items with no BOM or routing, inactive or unknown components, zero quantities, routing steps with no work center or time, and BOM loops. Edits nothing.

plugins.name: fairmake-calibration-due
plugins.description: Fairmake Calibration Due: gauges overdue or due soon, never calibrated, and work orders measured with a gauge that was overdue or had failed calibration, with a due-date calendar. Releases no hold.

plugins.name: fairmake-capacity-load
plugins.description: Fairmake Capacity Load: open operation hours by work center and week against available hours, overloaded weeks, past-due load and work centers with no calendar. Reschedules nothing.

plugins.name: fairmake-cost-variance
plugins.description: Fairmake Cost Variance: standard against actual cost by work order (material, labor, overhead), with a variance review draft for the production manager. Posts nothing.

plugins.name: fairmake-cycle-counts
plugins.description: Fairmake Cycle Counts: counted against system quantity with tolerances by ABC class, repeat variances, lines not counted and accuracy by class, with an adjustment list for approval. Posts nothing.

plugins.name: fairmake-edi-asn-errors
plugins.description: Fairmake EDI ASN Errors: advance ship notices (856) against customer POs (850) and shipment records: missing or late ASNs, quantity mismatches, items not ordered, SSCC problems. Transmits nothing.

plugins.name: fairmake-edi-invoice-check
plugins.description: Fairmake EDI Invoice Check: your invoices to customers (EDI 810 or tables) against their purchase orders (850): price and quantity differences, items not ordered, unknown POs and duplicates. Transmits nothing.

plugins.name: fairmake-hts-codes
plugins.description: Fairmake HTS Codes: tariff codes and countries of origin checked for gaps, format and consistency with your own code list and with customs entry lines. No classification advice; files nothing.

plugins.name: fairmake-job-margins
plugins.description: Fairmake Job Margins: quoted against actual cost and invoiced amount per job, with losses, overruns, under-billing and margins by customer and estimator. Changes no price.

plugins.name: fairmake-labor-efficiency
plugins.description: Fairmake Labor Efficiency: standard hours earned against direct hours clocked by work center, indirect time, and hours or completions with nothing on the other side. By work center, names masked.

plugins.name: fairmake-landed-cost
plugins.description: Fairmake Landed Cost: freight-in, duty and brokerage bills matched to receipts and to the landed cost allocated into item cost. Not a goods three-way match; posts nothing.

plugins.name: fairmake-late-purchase-orders
plugins.description: Fairmake Late Purchase Orders: open PO lines past due, unconfirmed, promised after the production need date or over-received, by supplier, with delivery status requests. Changes no PO.

plugins.name: fairmake-lot-traceability
plugins.description: Fairmake Lot Traceability: breaks in the chain from received lots through production to shipments: missing lots, lots never received or used before receipt, unknown shipped lots and serials shipped twice.

plugins.name: fairmake-machine-downtime
plugins.description: Fairmake Machine Downtime: availability, MTTR and MTBF per machine from MES downtime exports, chronic stop reasons, and stops with no reason, no end or overlapping. Changes no schedule.

plugins.name: fairmake-material-certs
plugins.description: Fairmake Material Certs: mill test reports and certificates of conformance on receipts against your purchase specs: missing, wrong lot or heat, out of spec or incomplete. Releases no hold.

plugins.name: fairmake-ncr-capa-aging
plugins.description: Fairmake NCR CAPA Aging: open nonconformances past the limit, overdue or unverified corrective actions, missing dispositions and root causes, and repeat defects with no CAPA. Owners masked; closes nothing.

plugins.name: fairmake-obsolete-inventory
plugins.description: Fairmake Obsolete Inventory: stock sorted into obsolete, slow-moving, excess and active by months since it moved and months of supply, inactive items with stock, and a reserve proposal. Scraps nothing.

plugins.name: fairmake-order-backlog
plugins.description: Fairmake Order Backlog: open customer order lines past due, due soon, never promised, promised after the requested date or on hold, by promise month and customer, with status update drafts. Changes no date.

plugins.name: fairmake-osha-300-log
plugins.description: Fairmake OSHA 300 Log: completeness of the injury and illness case log: missing fields, outcomes against day counts, day caps, privacy cases with names, open cases and late entries. Names masked; decides and files nothing.

plugins.name: fairmake-overhead-absorption
plugins.description: Fairmake Overhead Absorption: overhead applied to jobs (hours times rate) against overhead spent, by work center, with proposed rates. Posts nothing.

plugins.name: fairmake-preventive-maintenance
plugins.description: Fairmake Preventive Maintenance: PM tasks overdue by date or run hours, due soon, never done or with no interval, with a due-date calendar. Opens nothing in the CMMS.

plugins.name: fairmake-purchase-price-variance
plugins.description: Fairmake Purchase Price Variance: receipt prices against standard cost, price jumps and unit-of-measure slips by supplier, with a price query draft. Changes no standard.

plugins.name: fairmake-rebate-claims
plugins.description: Fairmake Rebate Claims: supplier rebate tiers reached and not claimed, claim-by dates passed, spend near the next tier and purchases above the agreed price, with a claim draft per agreement.

plugins.name: fairmake-reorder-points
plugins.description: Fairmake Reorder Points: stockouts, stock under safety stock, items at the reorder point, and reorder points that no longer fit usage and lead time. Places no order.

plugins.name: fairmake-retailer-deductions
plugins.description: Fairmake Retailer Deductions: customer deductions and retailer chargebacks by reason, late-ASN fines and shortages checked against your records, dispute-by dates and dispute drafts. Writes nothing off.

plugins.name: fairmake-scrap-yield
plugins.description: Fairmake Scrap Yield: scrap rates against standard by work order with the cost of the excess, missing reasons and counts that do not add up, by work center and reason. Posts no scrap.

plugins.name: fairmake-shelf-life
plugins.description: Fairmake Shelf Life: expired lots on hand, lots expiring soon or with no expiry, and shipments that went out expired, short-dated or out of first-expired-first-out order, with an expiry calendar.

plugins.name: fairmake-supplier-scorecards
plugins.description: Fairmake Supplier Scorecards: on-time delivery, rejects in ppm and price against PO per supplier, weighted and ranked, with a scorecard draft per supplier. Disqualifies nobody.

plugins.name: fairmake-wip-aging
plugins.description: Fairmake WIP Aging: open work orders aged by days since release, stale and past-due orders, and closed orders still holding WIP. Closes nothing.
